questions.question: The longest side of the obtuse triangle is 7 cm and the other two sides of the triangle are 4 cm and 5 cm. Find the area of the triangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct application of Heron's Formula is the fastest method here.

Semi-perimeter s = (4 + 5 + 7) ÷ 2 = 8 cm.

Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = √[8 × (8 − 4) × (8 − 5) × (8 − 7)]

Area = √[8 × 4 × 3 × 1] = √96 = 4√6 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lengths of the sides of the triangle are a = 4 cm, b = 5 cm, and c = 7 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Heron's Formula: Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Where 's' is the semi-perimeter of the triangle, given by s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, we calculate the semi-perimeter (s):

⇒ s = (4 + 5 + 7) ÷ 2

⇒ s = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

⇒ Now, substitute the values into Heron's formula:

⇒ Area = √[8 × (8 − 4) × (8 − 5) × (8 − 7)]

⇒ Area = √[8 × 4 × 3 × 1]

⇒ Area = √96

⇒ Area = √(16 × 6)

⇒ Area = 4√6 cm²

*(Note: We can verify it is an obtuse triangle because 7² > 4² + 5² i.e., 49 > 16 + 25)*

**∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of any triangle when all three side lengths are known, without needing the height of the triangle.

Obtuse Triangle Condition

A triangle is classified as obtuse if the square of the longest side is strictly greater than the sum of the squares of the other two sides (c² > a² + b²).

Other Area Formulas

Area = (1 ÷ 2) × base × height. Alternatively, Area = (1 ÷ 2) × a × b × sin(C) if two sides and the included angle are given.

questions.question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

9 and 3

I. 7 × 4 ÷ 2 - 9 + 3 = 22

II. 9 + 4 - 6 × 3 ÷ 2 = -10
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

I. Given equation : 7 × 4 ÷ 2 - 9 + 3 = 22

After interchanging the given two numbers 9 and 3 the equation is as follows : 7 × 4 ÷ 2 - 3 + 9 = 22

⇒ 7 × __**4 ÷ 2**__ - 3 + 9 = 22

⇒ __**7 × 2**__ - 3 + 9 = 22

⇒ __**14**__ - 3 __**+ 9**__ = 22

⇒ __**23**____** - 3**__ = 22

⇒ 20 ≠ 22

LHS ≠ RHS

II. Given equation : 9 + 4 - 6 × 3 ÷ 2 = -10

After interchanging the given two numbers 9 and 3 the equation is as follows : 3 + 4 - 6 × 9 ÷ 2 = -10

⇒ 3 + 4 - 6 × __**9 ÷ 2**__ = -10

⇒ 3 + 4 - __**6 × 4.5**__ = -10

⇒ __**3 + 4**__ - 27 = -10

⇒ __**7 - 27**__ = -10

⇒ -20 ≠ -10

LHS ≠ RHS

∴ Here, Both equations I and II are not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both I and II".**

• A** higher CRR** means banks have **less funds **available to lend,** reducing liquidity** in the system.
 
• A **lower SLR **means banks have **more funds available to lend,** increasing liquidity in the system.
